yarn test:app --watch=false: 4 failures in this file, all 'AssertionError: expected +0 to be 1' from assertSelectedElements.
(1) 'lasso selection modes > should select a rectangle whose corner is clipped by the lasso in overlap mode' (line 247), '> should select a fully enclosed rectangle in both modes' (line 262), '> should apply a changed selection mode to the next lasso stroke' (line 287). Diagnosed root cause: the describe('lasso selection modes') beforeEach only calls render(<Excalidraw />); in jsdom h.state.width and h.state.height stay 0, so h.app.visibleElements is empty and the lasso trail has no elements to select (verified: with h.state.width = 1000; h.state.height = 1000; set after render, a pointer lasso around the rectangle selects it). Fix: in that describe's beforeEach, after `await render(<Excalidraw />);`, add `h.state.width = 1000;` and `h.state.height = 1000;` (as packages/excalidraw/tests/lasso.test.tsx does). Keep every case and its expectations as they are.
(2) 'lasso reselection > should allow ctrl+alt lasso reselection when starting inside the active common bounds' (line 197, pre-existing test that passed before this run). Cause: the lasso now honours appState.boxSelectionMode, whose default is "contain" (Wrap); this test's diamond lasso clips rectA's corners, so in Wrap rectA is correctly not selected. The test encodes Overlap behaviour. Fix: in that test, call `API.setAppState({ boxSelectionMode: "overlap" });` right after `API.setElements([rectA, rectB]);` and keep its expectation assertSelectedElements([rectA.id]) unchanged. Change nothing else in the file.
